text_block_list.text:
During training, King Halo's
movements were somehow off.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kh...!
Why... did I lose my breath halfway through...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Such a weak run...
It's completely unworthy of the King's name...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Eh, y-yes, I'm fine.
It's nothing... No problem at all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
For a first-rate lady to collapse like this...
Surely, it must be some kind of mistake...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This time for sure, I'll show you a powerful run—!
—However, King Halo remained lackluster even after that.

She might be accumulating fatigue from repeated races.
It looks like we'll need to review her upcoming schedule...
